dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Veterans Affairs law enforcement personnel whose positions might otherwise be downgraded.
dimensions.evidence: covered VA position means a position carrying out law enforcement functions within the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Protects affected employees from losses of grade or pay and restores prior status and retroactive pay.
dimensions.evidence: Any employee occupying such a position shall receive all pay to which they otherwise would have been entitled.

dimensions.assessment: Involves retroactive pay restoration and restricts the use of federal funds for position downgrades, but no specific total cost is stated.
dimensions.evidence: no Federal funds may be used to propose, initiate, or carry out a position downgrade for any such position.

dimensions.assessment: Applies a specific statutory prohibition on classification actions and position downgrades across specified federal agencies regarding VA law enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: No official in the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Office of Personnel Management, or any other department or agency may propose, initiate, or carry out a position downgrade

dimensions.assessment: Provides retroactive relief starting October 1, 2025, and permanent statutory prohibition moving forward.
dimensions.evidence: beginning October 1, 2025, and ending on the date of the enactment of this Act shall have no force or effect.

missing_information: Total number of VA law enforcement positions affected
Total cost of retroactive pay and implementation
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits downgrading law enforcement positions within the Department of Veterans Affairs and reverses recent downgrades, affecting VA law enforcement personnel and operations.
